transcript:
**Agent:** Thank you for calling TechSolutions! This is Alex speaking. How can I assist you today?

**Customer:** Hi Alex, this is Jamie. I’m having some issues with my billing. I was charged for the Pro plan even though I downgraded last month.

**Agent:** I’m sorry to hear about the billing discrepancy, Jamie. Let me pull up your account to see what happened. Could you please confirm your email address for verification?

**Customer:** Sure, it’s jamie.smith@example.com.

**Agent:** Thank you, Jamie. I see your previous subscription was changed to the Basic plan last month, but the Pro plan charge was still processed due to a system error. I apologize for the inconvenience.

**Customer:** That’s frustrating! I didn’t expect to see that charge. When can I get my refund?

**Agent:** I can process your refund right away. It should reflect back in your account within 3-5 business days. Would you like me to also verify that your current plan is set to Basic?

**Customer:** Yes, please do. I want to make sure there are no more surprises!

**Agent:** All set! Your account is confirmed on the Basic plan now. Is there anything else I can help you with—maybe some features or if you’re considering an upgrade in the future?

**Customer:** Actually, I was looking at the feature list for the Pro plan. It has some tools I think might be useful for our team.

**Agent:** The Pro plan does come with advanced analytics and collaboration tools. We’re offering a 15% discount for the first three months if you're interested in upgrading today.

**Customer:** That sounds tempting. Can you send me the details to my email? I need to discuss it with my team before making a decision.

**Agent:** Absolutely! I’ll send over the Pro plan details along with the promotional offer to your email. Is there anything else I can assist you with right now?

**Customer:** No, that’ll be all for now. Thanks for your help, Alex!

**Agent:** You’re welcome, Jamie! Thank you for your understanding. Have a great day!
